name: rate-limiter
description: Token-bucket advisory rate limiter per (session, skill). Fires on PreToolUse. Surfaces runaway tool-call loops in real time before pech/budget-watcher reports them post-hoc. Configurable per-skill via state/buckets.json. Advisory-only — never blocks.
